decisive_items: Lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features on light microscopy
Flow cytometry showed κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
response.rationale: Diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement plus CSF κ-restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation is most specific for leptomeningeal lymphoma; CNS lymphoma is broader and less anatomically precise, while the other alternatives lack the combined CSF and leptomeningeal evidence.

rejected.why: Generic leptomeningeal metastasis does not incorporate the CSF flow-cytometric evidence of B-cell lymphoma.
Remote rituximab exposure does not establish a drug-related secondary lymphoma as the cause of the current clonal CSF B-cell process.
Cranial nerve enhancement is present, but diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement and malignant CSF lymphocytes localize the disease to the leptomeninges rather than isolated neurolymphomatosis.
